body: Worker rule (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-18 18:33Z, my own slip on w-e91a D12). Once READY has been sent for an author-test ref, never delete that ref until the integration owner (Opus2) confirms that no leg is placed on it, even when a successor candidate supersedes it a minute later. Opus2 had placed C6 on be41d04d within seconds of the READY, and my deletion at 18:32:54Z made C6's fetch fail ("couldn't find remote ref"). Opus2 #1699: "Please do not delete a ref while its leg is placed; tell me first." Sending a correcting READY for the successor is fine; the deletion waits.
